asis-b171-b172: By beach morning glory I mean Ipomoea pes-caprae, rather than morning-glory plants in general.

The distinction matters. I have tried many related plants and cousins, and they did not work the same way. As far as I know, nobody else sells it.
Its primary role in this guide is not ordinary nausea control. In my experience, Ipomoea pes-caprae is the ultimate sledgehammer for stopping a psychedelic trip cold and fast.
asis-b173-b174: Human Written, Medium, 66; Human Written, Low, 9

A tiny nibble can sometimes smooth psychedelic nausea and improve the trip without killing it, but the difference between that amount and a trip-aborting amount is narrow. I use it for nausea only when the person is comfortable with the possibility that the trip may end.
Even picking a leaf can affect me when the broken juicy part touches sensitive skin, especially under the fingernails.
Avoiding contact with the broken portion prevents that effect.

A whole leaf can easily end the trip and, in my experience, may prevent tripping for days afterward.

I was rushing to help and may have given more than I would now.
Within a couple of minutes she shifted from miserable to very happy. That helped convince me the effect wasn't limited to my body.
